sentenceIntentions.text: An AI can give a useful answer and still make a costly mistake when it acts.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make the stakes of agent action recognizable.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand that a good answer alone does not make actions reliable.

sentenceIntentions.text: Agentic AI 2026 looks at what changes when we let a model do real work.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book and its practical subject.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Know this is a guide to software that lets AI act.

sentenceIntentions.text: Editing a file or using a service involves more than finding the right words.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Picture a file changing rather than an abstract autonomous agent.

sentenceIntentions.text: Someone has to decide what the system can change, remember, and pass to another tool.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Reveal the human choices behind an agent.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Wonder who sets the limits and what those limits allow.

sentenceIntentions.text: As jobs grow longer, even capable agents can lose track of the original request.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize why a long job needs more than a clever model.

sentenceIntentions.text: The book compares designs that handle those problems in different ways.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Describe the reading journey without listing jargon.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect comparisons rather than one universal design.

sentenceIntentions.text: Builders can follow what happens when a step fails or needs to be undone.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Identify the useful detail reserved for reading.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to understand failure and recovery in a real build.

sentenceIntentions.text: Before choosing your next agent, find out what its impressive demonstration may have left out.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Invite a more informed architecture choice.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel curious about the system behind a convincing demonstration.
